Lemma
[Tangent directions to the sphere are orthogonal to the radius]

↗ ex:spheres

For $\iota :S^{n-1}\hookrightarrow \mathbb R^n$, $\langle \omega ,d\iota _\omega (w)\rangle =0$ for every $\omega \in S^{n-1}$ and $w\in T_\omega S^{n-1}$.

Proof

\sketch The image of $d\iota _\omega $ is $(\mathbb R\omega )^\perp $.

□
